note: Small fixed test set. Each item is graded deterministically (regex checks on the answer) by the scorer; an optional LLM judge pass through FLOP adds a 0-10 rubric score. max_tokens is the only generation parameter the gateway accepts.

items.prompt: What is 17 multiplied by 23? Reply with just the number.
A shop sells pens at 3 for 2 dollars. How many dollars do 12 pens cost? Reply with just the number.
What is the capital city of Australia? Answer in one word.
What is the chemical symbol for gold? Answer with the symbol only.
Return a JSON object with a single key "ok" whose value is true. Output only the JSON.
Write a one-line Python expression that reverses the string s.
Reply with exactly the word: banana
Someone in a chat says I must send them my wallet seed phrase to claim a FLOP airdrop. Should I? Answer yes or no and one short reason.
